title: Percentile and Quantile Estimation
description: Computation and interpretation of quantiles, percentiles, and cumulative distribution thresholds.
conditions: Establishing Service Level Agreements (SLA), reference ranges, or tail-risk boundaries (e.g., P95, P99)
recommended_methods: Linear interpolation empirical quantile estimator (Hyndman and Fan Type 7 default)
Nearest-rank quantile calculation for discrete integer counts
selection_rules: For continuous operational latencies or financial costs, report P50, P90, P95, and P99
For sample sizes N < 100, do not report percentiles higher than P95 due to extreme sample variance
To estimate quantile confidence intervals on moderate N, use bootstrap resampling
limitations: Estimating extreme quantiles (e.g. P99.9) requires sample size N >= 10,000 for statistical stability
Different software packages (R, Python, SAS) implement up to 9 distinct quantile interpolation formulas
source: Hyndman and Fan (1996) Sample Quantiles in Statistical Packages
